posts.body: My first two children didn't really move around that much. Only a little move here and there especially in my rib cage. But my last pregnancy and this pregnancy its like they are having a party in my tummy. I have a wonderful video of my last pregnancy where my daughter kept moving til no end. Now I am expecting a son and he seems to be even more active than the last!

I've only got one child so it can be hard for me to comment as I don't have a comparison yet! But my daughter definitely moved around enough that I could feel it a lot - particularly in the evening, which was nice in the later stages so that hubby could see/feel the movement too! But ouch, a lot of the time it really hurt! I had a spot on my belly that literally felt like it had gone numb (like a pins and needles type feeling!) after all the kicks and punches that it seemed to get!

Well I guess @Akiram13 you're in for a lot of action once your son is born. My son kicked so hard I thought my stomach was going to tear apart. The most painful part was him kicking against my navel; since he has been born till date, he kicks especially when sleeping and he is super active.
I believe your son is being active and he will light up your home soon.

Yea I am excited to have a son this time and I can already tell that he will be a hand full. My eldest caused the most pain although she didn't move around much due to her being wrapped around the cord but she would push her self in my rib cage and cause a lot of uncomfortable pain. My second was just normal I guess my third felt like everyday she was trying to break out of my tummy although til today she tries to crawl away and go wherever she pleases she doesn't like being restricted in any area.
I am so looking forward for this pregnancy and all the new experiences I am already having with him. I just hope this time he will look more like me than his dad because my daughters are a complete copy of him. Its not right for the mom to carry her young and get no proof of or copied feature on her little ones hahaha. Or so I say.
Yup, it is now.  I don't know but mine kicks a lot specially if I took sugary things like Mango juice or chocolate. Yup, it seems like there's a circus down there.
